quote.text: he who wisheth one day to fly, must first learn standing and walking and running and climbing and dancing:—one doth not fly into flying!
quote.author: Friedrich Nietzsche, Thus Spake Zarathustra, Third Part, “The Spirit of Gravity”, trans. Thomas Common

stories.kicker: The Good Life · The Geneva Watch Auction
stories.headline: Phillips closed Geneva XXIV on 8 November without publishing a total
stories.dek: So this desk counted every published lot result: CHF 91,922,250 across 211 lots, against the CHF 74.8m its May sale was called a record for.

stories.headline: Petzl and C.A.M.P. both recalled ice axes as the climbing season opened
stories.dek: Petzl recalled 5,360 Nomic and Ergonomic axes in March after 26 shafts broke; C.A.M.P. recalled 2,230 more on 5 November. Nobody was hurt in either.

stories.headline: Singapore Airlines cut business class six inches wide on the A350
stories.dek: The 2027 seat unveiled on 6 November is 22 inches across, against 28 on the 2013 one. Reviewers spent the weekend arguing about the yellow instead.

stories.headline: Michał O. killed six in Kraków’s market square
stories.dek: Three more bodies were found at his home in Ostrowiec Świętokrzyski, 150km away. Sixteen were wounded, and Donald Tusk declared two days of national mourning.

stories.headline: LTA ordered Grab to pause driverless testing at Punggol junctions
stories.dek: A Grab shuttle running WeRide software braked and veered as a schoolgirl crossed in Punggol at 8.11am on 5 November. Its safety operator then took the wheel.

stories.headline: Mitsubishi’s Hi-Uni is where a pencil stops getting better
stories.dek: It and Tombow’s MONO 100 cost US$20 a dozen. Blackwing, on the same Californian cedar, is US$34 — and does not win the blind test.

stories.headline: Commerce extended its Affiliates Rule stay to 10 January 2027
stories.dek: The Bureau of Industry and Security published the extension on 9 November, the morning the rule was due to bite, and gave no reason for it.

stories.headline: Apple’s top 16-inch MacBook Pro now configures to $14,549
stories.dek: A 16-terabyte drive adds $7,000 and the jump to 128GB of memory adds $2,000. The same machine with 8TB cost $7,349 in March.

stories.headline: Godzilla Minus Zero opened to $31.6m and took the American No. 1
stories.dek: GKIDS set a company record, nearly tripling the $11.4m opening of Godzilla Minus One. Japan’s own weekend figure has still not been published.

stories.kicker: The Family Desk · The WHO Activity Report
stories.headline: A quarter of adolescents told the WHO of no active day in a week
stories.dek: A pooled analysis of 389 surveys and 3.2 million 11-to-17-year-olds, published 4 November, finds the figure has not moved since 2010.

stories.kicker: The Macro Desk · The War Premium
stories.headline: A falling Brent price, not growth fear, drove the week’s bond rally
stories.dek: The US ten-year yield fell 5bp on the week to 4.86 per cent while its real yield rose 1bp. The implied breakeven did all the work, collapsing from 2.29 to 2.23.

stories.headline: A Brazilian trial found squeezing a handgrip beat squeezing with the legs
stories.dek: Four weeks of handgrip holds cut awake diastolic pressure by about 4.5 mmHg against controls; the identical protocol done with the legs moved nothing at all.

stories.headline: Kabukiza puts December’s tickets on sale at ten o’clock on 14 November
stories.dek: Seats run from ¥4,500 to ¥17,000 across three daily programmes, and anyone aged 30 or under can buy a half-price same-day seat.

stories.headline: China made 221,900 AI cartoon dramas in six months and the pay collapsed
stories.dek: Revenue per ten thousand views fell from 30–100 yuan to 5–10. One maker’s eleven series, sixteen episodes each, earned 9.60 yuan in total.
